product_metadata.title: futuresun Wood Stove Fan Heat Powered, 5-Blades Fireplace Fan Non Electric for Wood/Log Burner/Fireplace Eco Friendly and Efficient Fireplace Fan
features: 🔥【Environmental & Energy Saving】FUTURESUN wood stove fan is designed in small size and light in weight. It doesn’t require electricity, wood, or liquid fuel to function. Occasional dusting is the only maintenance that has to be done for these fireplace fans

🔥【Good Circulation of Heat】The cold spots in your home will be eliminated as the fan will help in proper air circulation. The maximum wind speed can reach 0.8M per second. All the warmth will keep the room because the fan doesn’t allow the heat to go up directly to the ceiling

🔥【An Ideal Purchase】The wood-burning stove fan has a pretty sturdy construction, While other than the initial cost of purchase, you don’t need to speed any electricity or fuel charges. Therefore, you can heat your home temperature quickly, uniformly, and stably without spending huge bucks
🔥【No Much Noise】The best aspect of a fireplace fan is that ‘it’s powered by heat energy, and not by fuel or electricity, so there’s no sound even when the fan is working at high-speed
